name: Microgrid PCC reactive-power controller
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Forms the assigned resource adjustment from the measured PCC reactive power and its operating target.
description: Forms the assigned resource adjustment from the measured PCC reactive power and its operating target. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “PCC reactive power and target” at the input and “Reactive-power adjustment” at the output. Power direction conventions must remain explicit.
